records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal year 2025 increased $57.0 million, or 18 percent, to $374.0 million from $317.0 million in the first quarter of fiscal year 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from our audio products increased $23.2 million, primarily driven by higher smartphone unit volumes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The cash flow used in operations during the corresponding period of fiscal year 2024 was related to the cash components of our net income and an $82.0 million unfavorable change in working capital, primarily as a result of an increase in inventory and accounts receivables, partially offset by an increase in income taxes payable.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 50.5 percent in the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, up slightly from 50.3 percent in the first quarter of fiscal year 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash generated from operations was $87.2 million for the first three months of fiscal year 2025 versus $39.8 million used during the corresponding period of fiscal year 2024.
